audit.why: HARD 8/10 is right at a 50.09% win rate over 553 games: Brand owns the ranged phase (Q 1050, W 900 vs Akali's 550 melee Q) and loses every window after Perfect Execution comes online because he has no dash and no escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted itself on all seven rows: the full layer said Akali 0-6, the content layer and the packet said Brand 0-6, and the full-layer whys for rows 4-6 described BRAND winning under an Akali verdict.
audit.why: Kit-grounded split: Akali's only ranged tool before 6 is Shuriken Flip (825, 16s at rank 1) and her Q is 550 melee-range, so Brand's 1050/900 poke owns levels 1-5. At 6 Perfect Execution is a 675-range double dash ending in an execute, and Twilight Shroud is free to cast on 20s and makes her unselectable — Brand has no dash, no escape and no way to hold his stun through the untargetable window, so 6 onward is hers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 -> Brand (full side + rating; content win[0..3] already reads Brand). Rows 4-6 -> Akali (full side already Akali; content win[4..6] moved to Akali). All whys on both layers rewritten to match their new verdict, proposed as one atomic chart group.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no digit (lint), and the two decisive interactions were absent: Perfect Execution's execute threshold and Assassin's Mark's auto-attack reset as the burst tell. Sear's ablaze requirement versus an unselectable target was also never stated.
audit.why: Sear only stuns an ablaze target; inside Twilight Shroud Akali cannot be selected at all, so both the ablaze application and the stun are unavailable until she exits. Perfect Execution's recast executes below a health threshold, so the health bar is the wrong thing to read. Assassin's Mark empowers her next attack when she leaves the energy ring — the wind-up is the cue to step away.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns (W 20s rank 1, E 16s rank 1, R 120/90/60) written into breakdown.cooldowns; execute threshold into phases[4].why and whys[4]; Shroud unselectability into dontsFull[2].d and dosFull[0] context.

audit.whatIsWrong: 18 lint findings: 15 misgendered fields, two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), one digit-free cooldowns field. report[8] also told the reader to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' — Akali has no meaningful sustain.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists akali as female; the anti-heal clause was template residue from a sustain enemy.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, bleeds replaced with kit-grounded bodies, anti-heal clause replaced with the Zhonya's call that actually matters here.
